newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Stuart takes five wickets, Pakistan 130 for seven.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Stuart takes five wickets, Pakistan 130 for seven.

text.p: Australia pace bowler Anthony Stuart finished with the remarkable figures of five for 26, including a hat-trick, as Pakistan slumped to 130 for seven in their World Series limited overs match on Thursday.
Stuart's career-best figures from his allotted 10 overs put Austraia in a commanding position and included the 12th hat-trick in limited overs cricket.
Stuart, playing in only his third one-day match for Australia, dismissed Ijaz Ahmed, Mohammad Wasim and wicketkeeper Moin Khan in successive deliveries to rout Pakistan's top order.
In his sixth over with the new ball, Stuart lured Ijaz and Wasim to edge faint catches to wicketkeeper Ian Healy before Moin deflected a thicker edge to Australia captain Mark Taylor at first slip.
Stuart had earlier removed opener Aamir Sohail and number three batsman Zahoor Elahi in the space of four balls.
The previous limited overs hat-trick was taken by Zimbabwe pace bowler and chicken farmer Eddo Brandes in his side's defeat of England on January 3.
Pakistan captain Wasim Akram was the sixth wicket to fall, run out for 33.
Stuart was also involved in the fall of the seventh wicket, taking a good, low catch on the boundary to dismiss opener Inzamam-ul-Haq for 64 from the bowling of Michael Bevan.
Inzamam and Wasim had put on a partnership of 63 for the sixth wicket,
Shahid Afridi was 20 not out and the new batsman was Saqlain Mushtaq.
